paper_title: RADES axion search results with a High-Temperature Superconducting cavity in an 11.7 T magnet
notes: RADES haloscope search with HTS (ReBCO) coated cavity in 11.7 T dipole magnet at CERN SM18. Mass range 36.5676-36.5699 ueV (554 kHz around 8.842 GHz). Limit varies between g_agamma ~ 6.3e-13 GeV^-1 (low-mass side, less data) and 1.59e-13 GeV^-1 (best sensitivity); encoded as two endpoint values spanning the probed mass range — the actual limit fluctuates within this band bin-by-bin (no numerical table provided).
